user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to place and track orders, so that I can purchase items and monitor their delivery status.
As a Customer, I want to browse and manage products, so that I can find and interact with the product catalog.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage j w t key end point operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to interact with client details impl functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
